source: C. Rimbault et al., Phys. Rev. ST Accel. Beams 9, 034402 (2006), Table II and footnote 3
normalization: All channels use the common electron-positron luminosity. The source calls BW and BH cross sections effective. Their denominators are not the photon-photon or electron-photon luminosities.
particle_convention: Individual electron plus positron daughters, not pair events
uncertainty: The source does not give Monte Carlo errors for these entries. The comparison exports explicitly assumed equivalent-crossing count-variance scenarios, without treating them as source-certified errors.
rounding: Use the printed cross sections directly. Dividing separately rounded counts by separately rounded luminosity need not reproduce their final digit.
